channel.title: Department of Water Supply
channel.description: County of Hawaiʻi Department of Water Supply

item.title: WAIOHINU – NAALEHU (Public Water System #108) customers – Precautionary Boil Water notice
item.description: The County of Hawaii, Department of Water Supply (DWS) has issued a Precautionary Boil Water notice for WAIOHINU and NAALEHU customers on Public Water System #108. Customers should boil their water for at least one minute before drinking or cooking.

item.title: Pāhala Boil Water Notice CANCELLED
item.description: The Precautionary Boil Water Notice for Pahala customers that the Department of Water Supply issued on August 12 has been CANCELLED. Water is safe to drink.

item.title: Water service could be interrupted by wind-related power outages
item.description: Prepare for Drinking Water Needs Ahead of Approaching Storm. The Department of Water Supply advises customers to prepare for their drinking water needs, as water service could be interrupted by extended power outages islandwide.

item.title: Water main break – Kailua-Kona customers without water
item.description: A water main break has left Kailua-Kona customers without water this morning. Crews are on scene. Service is expected to return later today.

item.title: South Kona Water Conservation Notice
item.description: Water Conservation Notice Issued for All South Kona Customers. AFFECTED AREAS: HONALO, KAINALIU, KEALAKEKUA, HONAUNAU, HOOKENA; SOUTH KONA. Please use less water where you can.

item.title: DEPARTMENT OF WATER SUPPLY UPDATE AS OF 8/15/2026
item.description: This is a general Department of Water Supply update. Most customers have water supplied through normal DWS infrastructure. Crews continue routine maintenance across the island.

item.title: Water Board regular meeting scheduled
item.description: The Water Board of the County of Hawaii will hold its regular monthly meeting. The agenda is posted at the DWS office.
